name: Inventory Reservation
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
*   Audience: Enthusiastic Retailer (cares about improvements/new features).
*   Input: A single PR description regarding automation of physical item reservations on order approvals via a system service execution trigger (SECA).
*   Format/Structure:
    *   New features/enhancements: Problem, Solution, Impact (3-4 sentences).
    *   Bug fixes: "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]." (1 sentence).
*   Style Guide:
    *   Simple, active voice.
    *   Granular but concise.
    *   Professional, utility-focused tone.
    *   **No AI Slop**: Avoid "enhanced", "streamlined", "seamless", "robust".
    *   **No Exclamation Points**: Only periods.
    *   **No dev-time bugs**: Don't mention "fixes" or "issues" found during development of new features.
    *   **True Bug Fixes**: Use "Fixed a bug...".
*   Input Analysis:
    *   Title: "Improvement: Moved reserve#OrderItems call to a new SECA on approve#Order to ensure automatic reservation on order approval".
    *   Body: "Moved reserve#OrderItems call to a new SECA on approve#Order to ensure automatic reservation on order approval."
